metadata.scope: all QK/ReLU/weight/headsum stages charged; private allocations/initial copies outside both APIs; output/scratch reused; no per-profile IO checks
metadata.cleanup_ownership: collector holds original prepared item through all correctness/profiles; generic proxy close is non-owning

before.device_work_semantics: busy is summed task duration; union/overlap are activity. Device span includes inter-task gaps but omits first enqueue and host/profiler overhead; none is unprofiled end-to-end latency

metrics.semantics: exported per-task values; no ratios summed, no denominator or roofline inferred
